name: FeedFix — Google Shopping Feed Audit, Fix & Re-Check (Local, Private)
description:
How do I audit my Google Shopping feed (.csv / .tsv), repair the formatting errors automatically, and re-audit the repaired file so I can prove what was fixed and see exactly what still needs my decision?
WHAT IT FIXES ON ITS OWN
• Availability values mapped to the required enums ("In Stock" → in_stock)
• Price formats normalized ($19.99 → 19.99 USD)
• http:// links upgraded to https://
• Relative image URLs made absolute
• HTML stripped from descriptions
• Missing condition filled with the platform default
WHAT IT REPORTS — BUT NEVER SILENTLY CHANGES
• GTINs failing the check-digit test (a typo'd barcode can't be "repaired" without inventing data)
• Duplicate ids, sale_price ≥ price, missing required attributes
• Promotional / ALL-CAPS titles, missing identifiers, preorder without a date
Every fix is logged old → new with the reason. The re-check verdict tells you plainly: PASS, or NOT READY with the blocking errors listed.
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
On a seeded 12-product test feed with 21 planted problems: 10 auto-repaired, re-check confirmed the 11 human-decision items, 0 new issues introduced.
100% LOCAL & PRIVATE — no upload, no account, no subscription. Your feed (your whole catalogue and pricing) never leaves your computer.
Windows 10/11, no other software needed. You get the repaired feed file + a plain-English fix report.
Scope: file-level data-spec errors. Account-level issues (suspensions, misrepresentation) can't be read from a feed file — anyone who promises otherwise is guessing.
